## VaultClaims interface

Claims embedded in a JWE token, as returned by [AuthorizeResult](./wasm.authorizeresult.md)<!-- -->.

The raw secret value (`val`<!-- -->) is deliberately \*\*absent\*\* — it is never part of `authorize()`<!-- -->'s return shape. Read the secret through [SecretAccessor](./wasm.secretaccessor.md) instead.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface VaultClaims 
```
